name: ZclockID Enterprise v1.0.3
summary: Appliance Host Firewall & Port Protection with Netfilter/UFW integration, default deny ingress, and custom port rules
notes:
### What's Changed in v1.0.3:
* **Appliance Host Firewall & Port Protection:** Full Linux Netfilter/UFW firewall integrated into Access Control > Host Firewall & Hardening.
* **Master Firewall Switch:** Global switch to easily turn the firewall ON or OFF without risking lockout.
* **Default Deny Policy:** Automatically enforces Default Ingress DROP/DENY ALL and Default Egress ALLOW ALL when active.
* **Essential Service Autoprotection:** Pre-seeded rules for Active Directory, Kerberos (88/464), DNS (53), SMB (445/139), NetBIOS, RPC (135/49152-65535), FreeRADIUS (1812/1813), NTP (123), SNMP (161), SSH (22), and HTTPS (443).
* **Custom Firewall Rules CRUD:** Add, edit, delete, and enable/disable custom ingress rules by protocol (TCP/UDP/BOTH), port/range (e.g. 8080 or 3000-3005), and source network CIDR.
* **Remote Access Guarantee:** Built-in safeguard ensures SSH (22) and Web GUI (443) rules are strictly enforced first before activating packet filtering.
